Name: Stardew Hypnos - Sleeping Overhaul
Author: apdapreturns
Description:
[size=5][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][b]Stardew Hypnos - Sleeping Overhaul[/b][/font][/size]
[u]                                                                                       [/u]
[size=5][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=3][b]Stardew Valley sleeping improvements[/b][/size][/font][/size]
[size=5][url=http://github.com/davicr/StardewHypnos][img]http://img.shields.io/github/license/davicr/StardewHypnos?style=flat-square.png[/img][/url]﻿[/size]
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=5][size=3]sleep in, enter NPC homes[/size] [size=3]whenever you want![/size][/size][/font]
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=5]
[b]1. Information[/b]
[size=3]﻿Stardew Hypnos allows farmers to:
[/size][/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]Sleep in beds owned by NPCs, being able to restrict this feature to only romantic partners (default), friends (with a minimum of hearts configuration) or just everyone.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]Enter friend or bachalor(ette) houses at any time.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]Widely configure Hypnos options, enabling easy extension of the modification.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=5][b]2. Configuration[/b][/size][/font]
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=5][size=3]1. MinimumRelationship =>[size=5] [size=3]T﻿he minimum relationship type needed to use the new features.[/size][/size][/size][/size][/font][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]OnlyPartners: ﻿NPCs must be dating, engaged or married with the Farmer[/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]Friends: NPCs must be friends with the Farmer[/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]Everyone: ﻿NPCs have no bond restrictions with the Farmer (note: doors will only be open for friends, not everyone.)[/size][/font][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][/font]
[/list][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=3]2. MinimumFriendshipHearts => The amount of hearts needed to be considered a friend with a NPC.[/size][/font][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=3]
3. KeepFriendDoorsOpen => Whether doors should be open at all times for locations owned by allowed NPCs.
4. NPCsByWarp => ﻿Collection with allowed NPCs in a certain location.
5. BedTileIndexes =>﻿ Collection of bed tile indexes in a tilesheet.
6. BlacklistedBedTiles﻿ => ﻿Collection of blacklisted bed locations by map names.[/size][/font]
[size=5][b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]... and
3. Thanks[/font][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=3]SMAPI developers[/size][/font]

[/list]
